rows.title: The germinal products set's own review: germinal answers in their species blocks, its unfinished-species messages, its shorter Addresses card and its confirmation page
rows.detail: A trader reviewing a germinal products notification needs to read back what the germinal pages asked for: a total gross weight in kilograms that may be a decimal, a number of packages, a storage temperature and the germinal identification details, including the details that are only kept in this service. The germinal set has its own copy of the review, so the live animals review keeps the rows it shows today. The germinal set never asks for additional details, a county parish holding number or a permanent address, so its review shows no row for them and asks nothing of them before submit. Where a selected species is short of what submit needs, the review names that species and links to its block, whether one species or several are selected. Once the notification is submitted, its confirmation page takes the trader back to the germinal products list rather than the live animals one.
acceptanceCriteria: In the germinal products set's review, each species block shows 'Total gross weight' with the weight entered followed by ' kg', so a weight entered as 12.5 reads back as '12.5 kg', and 'Number of packages' with the count entered (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-083; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022)

In the germinal products set's review, the first species block of the first commodity card shows a 'Temperature' row with the chosen answer, on every germinal notification (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-085; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021)

In the germinal products set's review, a germinal species block shows 'Identification details' as a list of each identifier field's own label and the value saved against it, the donor name or identifier, the collection and production dates and the identification mark included (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-087; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-042)

The live animals set's review shows the species rows 'Commodity code', 'Common name', 'Species' and 'Number of animals', and those four only (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p13-040; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-110)

The germinal products set's review Addresses card shows exactly one row for each consignment address role, labelled with that role's own heading and showing the address chosen for it (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-110, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-111; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-056)

A germinal products notification with origin details, a commodity selection, consignment details, an import reason, arrival details, transport details, its consignment addresses, a contact address and at least one identifier saved for every selected species has nothing marked unfinished on its review and can be submitted (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-125; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p13-076; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018)

In the germinal products set's review, a selected species with no package count is named with 'Enter the number of packages for <species>', the species name in lower case, and that entry links to the species' own block (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-057, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-059; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-110)

In the germinal products set's review, a selected species with a package count but no entry holding one of its four identifiers is named with 'Enter at least 1 animal identifier for <species>', the species name in lower case, and that entry links to the species' own block; it is named the same way when it is the only species selected as when several are (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-058, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-059; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-188)

After a germinal products notification is submitted, the link on its confirmation page back to the trader's notifications opens the germinal products set's list of notifications (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-056; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009)
notes: Rewrite of the existing row inc-105, keeping its requirements, dependencies, external dependencies and theme (germinal-products).

Pass 2 combines three slices that are one page in one feature folder: the germinal read-back rows (req-842), the germinal copy's readiness test, shorter Addresses card and confirmation return (req-1843) and its unfinished-species messages (req-1841). Building them apart would repeat the same germinal notification set-up, the same review render and the same ladder three times.

Re-distil 25 November: the only change to inc-105 is the new last criterion, the confirmation page's return to the germinal products list. req-1843 states it and no other row covers it: inc-182 builds the germinal declaration and submission but stops at the submit, and inc-141 builds the set root the link opens. The combiner should add inc-141 to this row's dependsOn when it keeps inc-105's id.

c-277 settles the identifier bar for germinal products: every selected species, a lone one included, needs one of its four identifiers before submit, so the prototype's lone-species exemption is not copied into the germinal set. c-134 settles that each short species is named in its own right rather than through one 'Complete species details' entry. Neither conflict overrules a claim this row rests on.

The live-animals half of the per-species messages is the identification row's requirement (req-879), held by the overview-and-review branch. Built in the germinal set's copy of check-answers, so it stays in the germinal-products theme and conflicts with no other branch.

The fourth criterion is a no-change guard on the live animals review: it proves the germinal rows went into the germinal copy and not the shared one. It asks for no edit to the live-animals check-answers folder, which the overview-and-review branch owns and which lands before this theme.

splitOff.why: It changes the review's Change links and where saving the changed page returns the trader. The links are built in the check-answers view-model rows, which theme overview-and-review owns, and that theme's rows already carry the note that their navigation was trimmed because EUDPA-774 owns it, which is the same blocker this requirement names.
It changes the declaration page's checkbox state and the review's Continue render, both in the declaration and check-answers feature folders that theme overview-and-review owns.
